headline: Pension reform: the 3 proposals of INPS President Fava alongside those of the parties
summary: The INPS president has put forward three proposals in the debate over the 2026 pension reform, alongside proposals from political parties. Details of the measures are not given.
why: INPS is Italy's national social security institute, which administers state pensions and therefore shapes the cost of the pension system for the public budget.
